postimage_derivation.boundary: These three digests were produced by transcribing cp01-derive.sql into a SQL client by hand. A transcription error cannot pass silently: cp01-apply.candidate.sql is generated from this JSON, not from what was transcribed, so it would recompute a different post-image and abort at CP01_POSTIMAGE_DRIFT before issuing any CREATE OR REPLACE. The independent reviewer should still re-run cp01-derive.sql read-only and reproduce these three values.
